emma_cs: Quick alert — AuroraBridge needs a short APAC demo window next Tue 09:00 SGT. Their staging load generators are tripping qps and token limits. Theyre requesting a 30h temporary uplift + two CIDR entries and region pin to asia-southeast-1. Renewal in 11 days; this demo is a key health check.

ryan_infra: Please paste exact CIDRs, model slug, and requested window. We'll scope the grant to the model only. Also flag if they want any special routing (sticky sessions, geo pin).

emma_cs: Owner is sam@aurorabridge.ai. Window: 2026-05-12T23:00Z -> 2026-05-14T05:00Z (30h). Peak qps ~1700, steady ~900. CIDRs: 52.59.100.0/24 and 18.196.64.0/19. Region: asia-southeast-1. Model: ab/demo-core -> redwood/mini-medium-v1-staging. They want sticky session routing for demo users and prefix caching enabled.

ops-bot: @ryan_infra created ticket OPS-6991: "AuroraBridge APAC demo temporary uplift + CIDR allow". Approval SLA 2h. https://redwood.ops/OPS-6991

ryan_infra: Reserving a short burst pool and adding the CIDRs to proxy allowlist. Nina, can you pre-warm KV cache, set concurrency bump to 18 and batch_max_tokens=320? Also create a sticky canary route.

nina_se: On it. Plan: warm top-12 prompt prefixes, concurrency=18, batch_max_tokens=320, prefix_cache TTL=600s, and sticky routing by session cookie for the canary. Spinning up warm canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: canary/redwood-mini-medium-v1-warm -> asia-southeast-1. ETA ~15m.

ryan_infra: Heads-up: I'll limit the grant strictly to model slug and those CIDRs + sticky SNI host if provided. Auto-revoke after window unless extension requested. Estimated uplift ~$720 for 30h.

emma_cs: cc @claire_ae please note uplift for renewal notes. If demo runs clean we'll surface as positive momentum. If they ask to extend we'll need AE + legal loop.

claire_ae: Noted. Will prepare renewal note and amendment template if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed but initial warm run showed elevated p95 (~420ms) due to a mis-sized instance. Re-provisioning a slightly larger warm instance.

nina_se: Fixed — increased instance size, re-warmed KV. Warm logs: "kv_cache_hits=93% ; p95=190ms". OPS-6991 updated.

ryan_infra: OPS-6991 updated: CIDRs 52.59.100.0/24, 18.196.64.0/19 added to proxy allowlist; model-limited burst pool allocated in asia-southeast-1; sticky route created; auto-revoke scheduled 2026-05-14T05:10Z. Rollback steps documented.

emma_cs: Confirmed with customer: smoke at 08:30 SGT passed, demo at 09:00 SGT ran as planned. Sam sent logs and a short recording. AE will include outcome in renewal playbook.

ops-bot: OPS-6991 status: completed. Auto-revoke scheduled.

ryan_infra: Closing loop — reach out here if they request extension.

emma_cs: Thanks team. Marking as positive renewal signal and noting the uplift numbers for the AE. :sparkles:
